up: Retrieve all compounds that are reported in the document with ChEMBL ID CHEMBL5303573. sql: SELECT DISTINCT md.chembl_id, md.pref_name, md.max_phase, md.molecule_type, cs.canonical_smiles FROM docs JOIN compound_records cr ON docs.doc_id = cr.doc_id JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON cr.molregno = md.molregno LEFT JOIN compound_structures cs ON md.molregno = cs.molregno WHERE docs.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL5303573' ORDER BY md.chembl_id ASC
